sourceMode: Authenticated MCP capture; isolated local review server

checks.name: Office evidence access
checks.detail: Unsigned API reads were rejected and the private capture was inaccessible as a static file.

checks.name: Real capture and honest connection status
checks.detail: Dashboard identifies the authenticated capture, account, timestamp and time zone; website REST reads remain disabled without a separate key.

checks.name: Automation over native records
checks.detail: 3 real captured shifts produced 6 owned findings with native source IDs; actual attendance was not inferred from scheduled or payroll data.

checks.name: Replay prevention
checks.detail: Repeating the same capture reused the persisted run ID and findings.

checks.name: Traceability into ShiftCare
checks.detail: Native links match the returned URLs, staff and assignment IDs stay separate, and actual call counts/scopes/timestamps are visible.

checks.name: Native proof and data boundaries
checks.detail: Native action 11221 is independently matched and all five stages are recorded. Copy now produces a get_action_item request rather than a duplicate create; no unsupervised write control or native browser persistence exists.

checks.name: Persisted review and responsive runtime
checks.detail: The authenticated review survived reload, desktop/mobile captures had no horizontal page overflow, and the browser made no ShiftCare mutation or uncaught exception.

observations: Capture age, account/time zone, native IDs, six owned findings, retained counts and native links are readable.
Native task 11221 is labelled with its historical 7 October read-back time; current completion is not polled.
Wide native tables scroll inside their panels. No horizontal page overflow was measured.
visualReview.limit: Inspection of recorded desktop/mobile viewports; not a complete device or accessibility certification.

productionLimit: Captured MCP reads and local rules are demonstrated. Website-owned OAuth, live REST credentials, hosted job storage and unattended native writes are not certified.
